subject: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumena.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Ortega <luis@lumena.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lumena is ready to move to a short pilot and we want to align on how we exchange the evaluation materials (sample prompt packs and a ~500-test case subset) with clear usage constraints.

High-level asks from our side:
- Mutual action plan (MAP) with milestone dates for data receipt, sandbox provisioning, and acceptance window.
- A constrained license: ephemeral access, no external redistribution, retention window of 90 days, secure deletion after closure.
- Tech constraints: we need to know the model variants you’ll run against and if we can run locally in our VPC for sensitive lanes.

Can you send a short MAP and a checklist so our legal and security teams can review? We’re aiming to start ingestion by Jul 24 and a short 2-week acceptance window.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call if helpful.

Elena Ruiz
Head of ML Ops, Lumena AI
elena@lumena.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumena.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access

Elena —

Appreciate the clear asks. I attached a short MAP draft and an ingress checklist to this message (see attachment stubs). High-level proposal below; I kept dates conservative to give security/legal time to review.

Proposed MAP (summary):
1) Jul 11 — Redwood sends MAP v1 + ingress checklist (this email) [attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf]
2) Jul 13 — Lumena returns security questionnaire + redlines [expected: security-questions.pdf from Lumena]
3) Jul 16–18 — Redwood provisions a sandbox (ephemeral tokens, restricted network egress) and uploads promptpack sample to sandbox
4) Jul 24 — Lumena ingests pilot dataset (up to 500 testcases) into sandbox; start 14-day acceptance window
5) Aug 7 — Acceptance complete; Redwood destroys residual copies per agreement (90-day total retention unless otherwise agreed)

Key constraints and asks from Redwood:
- Prompt pack should be provided as a compressed archive with a README explaining PII and target labels.
- We will run the pilot on a managed hosted endpoint by default. If Lumena requires VPC/on-prem execution for specific lanes, we can scope that as an add-on and estimate infra time (2–4 weeks).
- We require a signed MPA (or equivalent) that includes the ephemeral access and deletion commitments.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (MAP outline), ingress-checklist.xlsx (ingest metadata + expected file formats).

Next steps: Can your security team confirm by Jul 13? If yes, Karthik will follow up on the technical provisioning steps. Ben will send a short commercial note (deal outline) and a DocuSign for the MPA.

Happy to adjust timelines once we hear back — not trying to rush you, just trying to keep the runway tight.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumena.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jul 2028 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access

Folks —

I want to call out a few technical items so Lumena can validate they’re acceptable before we provision the sandbox:

1) Model variants and determinism
- We will run the trial against Redwood-hosted model variants we’ve validated for throughput. We can provide model version IDs and temperature/seed settings for reproducibility. If you require a specific open-model and local execution, that’s possible but needs extra lead time (we’ll need 2–3 days to produce container images and 7–14 days to validate on your infra).

2) Quantization & artifacts
- If Lumena supplies binaries or quantized weights for benchmark parity, we’ll need checksum/manifest files and a short provenance statement.

3) KV/prefix caching and test isolation
- We’ll run each test in an isolated session to avoid KV leakage across cases; however, if tests depend on shared context we should flag that in the README.

4) Security controls
- Ephemeral API keys with scoped RBAC will be used. We can provide audit logs for the duration of the trial. Post-acceptance, we will schedule a secure purge (we can produce a deletion certificate).

Please attach your filled security questionnaire (Luis/Elena) so I can pre-populate provisioning scripts. Also flag any non-standard network requirements (e.g., SFTP push instead of web upload).

Karthik
Principal Engineer, Infrastructure
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumena.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access

Elena —

Thanks — quick commercial notes to keep the deal thread aligned:
- Commitment: 2-week pilot; list price for pilot infra waived as a pilot credit.
- If Lumena opts for VPC/offline execution for any lane, we’ll include a one-time setup fee (estimate: $8k) and a separate SLA.
- I’ve created a short HubSpot deal for tracking (see link). I’ll also drop a DocuSign for the MPA with the 90-day retention and deletion clause — please look for a signature request from DocuSign LUM-7421.

If security signs off by Jul 13 we’ll plan to provision the sandbox on Jul 16.

Ben
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@lumena.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ingress agreement: exchanging testcases and sandbox access

Team —

All good on our side. Luis and I attached the filled security questionnaire and a small sample pack (promptpack-sample.zip, testcase-sample.jsonl). We confirm the 90-day retention and will sign the MPA as soon as we see the DocuSign.

A couple of clarifying notes:
- We’ll provide checksums for any binary artifacts by Jul 14.
- For the lanes with PII, we accept a hosted sandbox with strict egress rules and audit logs — we do not require on-prem for the pilot but might for production.

Next steps for us: sign DocuSign and drop the dataset on Jul 24 into the sandbox. Thanks for the clarity on isolation and deletion certificate.

Elena Ruiz
Head of ML Ops, Lumena AI

Attachments referenced in thread (stubs): MAP-draft-v1.pdf, ingress-checklist.xlsx, security-questions.pdf, promptpack-sample.zip, testcase-sample.jsonl
plain_text_summary: Lumena (external) requested a MAP and ingress checklist to exchange evaluation datasets (prompt packs and testcases). Redwood (Marissa + team) sent MAP v1, proposed timeline, and checklist. Karthik outlined technical constraints (model variants, quantization, ephemeral keys, audit logs). Ben confirmed commercial terms and DocuSign for MPA. Lumena returned signed security questionnaire and sample artifacts; plan is to upload the pilot dataset on Jul 24 with a 14-day acceptance window and 90-day retention before secure deletion.
